profile.description: Referred Elko-area prospect. Susan Goddard of Lamoille Country Fair specifically recommended Everything Elko Pumpkin Festival in her May 17, 2026 reply after advising that Lamoille Country Fair's local bounce-house provider was returning. The Pumpkin Festival is organized by Everything Elko, not by Susan/Lamoille Country Fair, Rides & Rods, Gold Rush Challenge, or Elko County Fair. Current Everything Elko contact trail identifies Katie at katie@everythingelko.com / 208-867-6512. The event is a recurring free, family-focused October festival at Lamoille Grove, but exact 2026 dates have not yet been verified from an official published event announcement; do not put dates in outreach until confirmed.

Adventure Zone Gmail contains no prior direct email to katie@everythingelko.com or erin@everythingelko.com; only Susan's referral mentions the Pumpkin Festival.
